post.title: How comedy clubs really make money: the two-item minimum
post.ig:
That two-item minimum? It's the real show.

Many clubs require two food or drink items per person; the Laugh Factory says it helps pay comics and keep tickets cheap.
Helium charges $10 ($5 per item) if you order nothing.
Example sold-out club, 200 seats: if comics get half, the club keeps $2,000 from tickets and $3,200 from drinks (two $10 drinks each, about 20% pour cost).
US households spent $643 on alcohol in 2024, $374 of it away from home (BLS).

Sources: Laugh Factory and Helium FAQs, BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey, bar trade benchmarks.
News and education, not financial advice.
